required_components: exact consenting Body War principal identifier
private_locator_contract.storage: private authenticated durable control record outside the public receipt
lifecycle: reserve the exact evidence-candidate identifier before OAuth
arm the deadline and parent-liveness monitor before OAuth
mark the candidate created atomically with evidence insertion
mark each cleanup and repeat-verification result
retain no activity values, provider activity identifier, token, raw payload, map, polyline, coordinate, or note
private_locator_contract.current_gap: No private durable control record currently prebinds the exact consenting Body War principal before OAuth. Postgres also generates the evidence UUID at insert time and addActivityEvidenceCandidate accepts no caller-supplied identifier, so the required exact candidate locator cannot be bound before OAuth.

triggers.condition: the primary witness process reaches success or any handled failure
the independent supervisor observes primary process termination or liveness loss
15 minutes have elapsed since OAuth start without terminal verified cleanup
triggers.claim_boundary: operating target only, not a crash-safe hard retention guarantee

cleanup_sequence.operation: dispose exact evidence candidate with reason consent_revocation
delete all Body War token rows for the exact principal and mark its provider-account metadata disconnected
verify exact evidence row and provider tokens absent, unrelated evidence untouched, and SuggestedTrack reset only when no other candidate remains

persistent_residue: auth principal, grants, consumed OAuth state, and durable session lifecycle
source Strava activity and provider-side records

provider_boundary.revokeProviderAccess_semantics: Body War-local token deletion and provider-account disconnection
provider_boundary.reason: A Strava revoke/deauthorize call is outside the selected three-call app-owned provider envelope and cannot be added silently.

required_acceptance_tests: start supervisor and prove independent Postgres connectivity before OAuth
prebind the exact consenting Body War principal in the private control record before OAuth without exposing it in the non-private receipt
prove an exact evidence identifier can be reserved before OAuth and used by the insert
kill the primary process after evidence insertion and prove supervisor cleanup
trigger the 15-minute path with a synthetic clock and prove cleanup
prove first and repeated evidence/token disposition results
prove unrelated candidates remain and track reset is conditional
prove memory backend and missing supervisor block before OAuth
prove supervisor writes no public private locator or activity values
prove supervisor performs zero provider network calls
authority_ceiling: This contract is no-effect design evidence only and authorizes no product mutation or cleanup execution.
